outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) rate
Physician perception of PQI utility and data trustworthiness
finding: While the implementation of PQI feedback led to an increase in technicity and a decrease in combined forceps/vacuum delivery rates, it did not improve VBAC rates, and a significant proportion of physicians expressed distrust in the data and anxiety related to the process.
mod_finding: The combined forceps/vacuum delivery rate decreased for both individual physicians and at the site level after PQI implementation (P < 0.001).
